strategy_name: Essential Goods Stockpile and Public Procurement
description: Protects essential goods through buffers procurement standards supplier development and governance.
Uses repair reuse remanufacturing recycling and reverse logistics to reduce material exposure.
Addresses opaque critical dependencies with tier mapping standards audits and worker voice.

strategy_name: Climate Adaptation and Site Risk Mapping
description: Assesses climate risk across suppliers ports routes warehouses and labor conditions.
Builds regional sourcing flexible routing and recovery capacity.
Builds verified upstream visibility with cybersecurity and data governance.
Maps trade exposure and tests resilience under tariffs sanctions and export controls.
Qualifies alternate suppliers and reduces dependency concentration.
